from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.request import urlopen

class CatalogParser(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.forms = []
        self.products = []
        self.in_form = False
        self.in_button = False
        self.button = ''
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        data = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'form':
            self.in_form = True
            self.forms.append(data)
        if tag == 'button' and self.in_form:
            self.in_button = True
        if tag == 'input' and self.in_form:
            self.forms[-1].setdefault('inputs', []).append(data)
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == 'button': self.in_button = False
        if tag == 'form': self.in_form = False
    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.in_button: self.button += data
        if data.strip() in ('Laptop', 'Phone', 'Tablet', 'Headphones', 'Watch'):
            self.products.append(data.strip())

html = urlopen('http://localhost:3100/').read().decode()
parser = CatalogParser()
parser.feed(html)
print('Products:', parser.products)
print('Button:', ' '.join(parser.button.split()))
print('Forms:', parser.forms)
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

class ActionParser(HTMLParser):
    action_name = None
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        data = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'input' and data.get('name', '').startswith('"'$ACTION_ID_'"'):
            self.action_name = data['name']

url = 'http://localhost:3100/'
parser = ActionParser()
parser.feed(urlopen(url).read().decode())
assert parser.action_name
boundary = 'catalog-sync-check'
body = (f'--{boundary}\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"{parser.action_name}\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\\r\\n--{boundary}--\\r\\n').encode()
request = Request(url, data=body, headers={'Content-Type': f'multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}'}, method='POST')
with urlopen(request) as response:
    html = response.read().decode()
    print('POST status:', response.status)
    print('Catalog rendered:', 'Laptop' in html and 'Sync latest catalog' in html)
PY"
